claims.claim: Open Dental costs about $179 to $199 per month.
claims.rationale: The fees page gives $199 as the current initial rate and keeps $179 only for offices that started before 2 February 2026, with $149 after 12 months, so a $179 to $199 range is neither the current published range nor the state before the dated change, and the pages read do not settle it as stated.

instances.quote: with some sources citing about $179–$199/month

notes: Eight own pages read on opendental.com, all HTTP 200. The .NET page (dotnet.html) came back with thin: true (1,314 characters) and was listed in needs_browser_read; pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): its browser read has the same text (installation requires Microsoft .NET on Windows workstations), so it changes no class and needs_browser_read is now empty (the Windows claims still rest on computerrequirements.html; C34 and C35 stay unverifiable). Six cited pages were read for causes (the per-vendor budget of 14 is now used up, 15 reads with the browser read), so other cited pages for C14 and C31 were not read. Pass 2 completeness: added C42 ($179 to $199, unverifiable) and instances for C04, C22 (both from one Perplexity table cell, which also says the $149 to $199 range applies after the initial term; read as a garbled qualifier, reviewer may disagree) and C31 (on-premise hardware required). The consistency check kept every wrong and stale class: C10, C14, C31 and C32 each rest on an explicit line of the vendor's own fees, cloud or requirements page, and C06 and C07 on the dated 2 February 2026 change from $179 to $199. Not coded because no type fits: the many open-source and open-database claims, MySQL database claims and API/data-access claims; note for the reviewer that the cited medixdental.com page says Open Dental moved from a GPL license to a proprietary one in version 24.4, which no own page read confirms. Name-only mentions, rankings, review ratings, Townie votes, savings comparisons, transparent-pricing opinions and conditional cloud-architecture lines (for example Open Dental (cloud-architected)) were not coded. Ambiguous Hybrid deployment labels were coded only where they also name a server. Judgement calls: C05 (~$150/mo estimated cost) is classed true against the $149 reduced rate; C26 ($430 cloud for one provider) is unverifiable because the cloud page prices by concurrent sessions, not providers; C34 and C35 (Mac, Linux) are unverifiable because the requirements page allows them only for the server; C31 (requires a local server) is classed wrong because the vendor offers Open Dental Cloud and customer-managed remote hosting, even though the cloud service is in limited release.
